summary: Full-Stack Developer with 2 years of production experience on a live enterprise inventory and financial management platform (Java / Spring Boot, ReactJS, MySQL/MariaDB). Builds full-stack web applications and RESTful web services, with a specialization in SQL stored procedure optimization and financial module development across purchasing, inventory, sales, and reporting -- cutting report load times by 60-70% and resolving 150-200+ production tickets. Experienced mentoring junior developers and translating business requirements into correct, auditable system behavior. Quick to ramp on large, unfamiliar codebases. Open to mid-level full-stack or backend roles, on-site in Cebu or fully remote.

achievements.text: Design, develop, test, debug, and maintain full-stack features across a ReactJS frontend and Java / Spring Boot backend on a live, multi-business-unit enterprise platform, following established coding standards.

Built ReactJS components integrated with Spring Boot RESTful web services, including data-heavy reporting grids (Wijmo FlexGrid) spanning purchasing, inventory, sales, and financial screens -- ensuring consistent, reconcilable output across all modules.

Cut high-volume financial report load times by ~60-70% by refactoring stored procedures -- converting CTEs to temp tables, adding targeted indexes, and rewriting non-sargable date filters -- eliminating locking bottlenecks on a MariaDB production database.

caseStudy.problem: High-volume financial reports were slow to load, with locking bottlenecks on the MariaDB production database.
caseStudy.solution: Refactored stored procedures: converted CTEs to temp tables, added targeted indexes, and rewrote non-sargable date filters.
caseStudy.result: Report load times cut by approximately 60-70%, eliminating the locking bottlenecks.

achievements.text: Diagnosed and resolved 150-200+ production tickets across all modules -- covering GL journal entry logic, AP/AR reconciliation, serial-number tracking, concurrency race conditions, and XLSX/PDF export defects.
Owned production-critical financial modules end-to-end within 18 months; partnered with business analysts and QA to translate business requirements into correct, auditable system behavior.
Mentored and onboarded OJT developers on system architecture, stored procedure design, and Git-based development workflows, reducing their ramp-up time significantly.
Assisted in creating frameworks and wireframes for project presentations within the Customer Experience team.
